figures.caption: (A) Reversed-phase HPLC profile of B. raniceps skin secretion fractionated on a Vydac C8 column. One antibacterial fraction is indicated as Br24. Differences of amino acids are highlighted in gray, ‘*’ indicates identical amino acids and ‘:’ indicates conservative substitutions.
